description:
Depots and maintenance buildings get levels. A level widens the maintenance radius, adds vehicles maintained, or cuts pollution, noise or upkeep. You buy each level in the building's window.

IN DEVELOPMENT. This is a test version, checked in the game on a few saves. Expect rough edges and changes. Keep a backup of any save you play with it.

HOW IT WORKS
- Open a depot or maintenance building and choose the Retrofit tab. It shows your company rank, the building's radius and vehicles, and one card per tree: the level, the upkeep after the next level, what the next level changes, and a buy button with the price.
- Each level is bought on its own, for money. A tree's highest level is your company rank, up to 15. When the next level needs a higher rank, the button shows "Rank N" and is greyed out.
- Buying a level rebuilds the building. The game then reassigns the vehicles it maintained within a game day, and some may move to another building in range. Lines are not affected.
- Levels cannot be sold or lowered. They are saved with the game.

THE FIVE TREES
- Maintenance radius: +5% per level (+75% at level 15).
- Vehicles maintained: +10% per level, or at least +1 vehicle (+150% or at least +15 vehicles at level 15).
- Pollution: -5% per level (-75% at level 15).
- Noise: -5% per level (-75% at level 15).
- Upkeep: -5% of the total upkeep per level (-75% at level 15).

COSTS
- Level 1 costs a tenth of the building's build price, and each level after that costs about a third more than the one before. Every tree has the same prices.
- Each level in the radius, vehicles, pollution or noise tree adds a quarter of the building's normal upkeep. The upkeep tree cuts the total upkeep by 5% per level.

WHICH BUILDINGS
- All road, tram, rail and water depots and maintenance buildings, including ones built before the mod was added. Depots from other mods get the tab too when they use the game's depot icons, are marked as a depot in their construction file, or sit in a depots/ folder.
- A newly placed building starts at level 0 in every tree.

NOT CHECKED YET
- Whether the game's own rebuilds keep the levels, for example electrifying a rail depot.
- What happens to leveled buildings when the mod is removed from a save.

COMPATIBILITY
- The mod replaces no game script. It wraps each depot's own build script: the depot is built as its author made it, then the levels are applied.
- It contains no files from the game.

Source and notes: https://github.com/WuphonsReach/tf3-depot-retrofits (MIT licence).
name: Depot Retrofits
summary: Depots and maintenance buildings get levels, bought in the building's window: a wider maintenance radius, more vehicles maintained, less pollution, less noise and lower upkeep.
